# Package httpapi

<!-- Generated by `go run ./cmd/apidoc` — do not edit by hand. -->

Package httpapi is the ApiPilot net/http adapter.

It implements the full ApiPilot request pipeline as http.Handler
middleware: correlation → content-negotiation → origin →
fetch-metadata → CSRF → exception mapping. Mirrors the C# pipeline,
the TypeScript Fastify adapter, and the Python ASGI adapter.

## const DateISO8601

DateISO8601 serializes dates as ISO 8601 strings (default).

## const DateUnixSeconds

DateUnixSeconds serializes dates as Unix epoch seconds (integer).

## const EnumAsNumber

EnumAsNumber serializes enums by underlying numeric value.

## const EnumAsString

EnumAsString serializes enums by name (default; stable across ordinal changes).

## func BuildOpenApiDocument

```go
func BuildOpenApiDocument(OpenApiOptions) map[string]any
```

BuildOpenApiDocument builds the OpenAPI document skeleton: openapi
version, info, empty paths, and components.schemas derived from the
options. Mirrors ApiPilotSchemaDocument.Build (C#). Path items are the
application's responsibility (e.g. via a router's OpenAPI integration).

## func ClientKey

```go
func ClientKey(*http.Request) string
```

ClientKey extracts the rate-limit key from the request. Defaults to
RemoteAddr host; falls back to "anonymous" when unavailable.

## func Diagnostics

```go

```

Diagnostics inspects the resolved options and binding resolver and

## func GenerateKeyMaterial

```go
func GenerateKeyMaterial() string
```

GenerateKeyMaterial generates a fresh 32-byte key, base64-encoded.

## func KeyRingDiagnostics

```go
func KeyRingDiagnostics(*CsrfKeyRing, bool) []Diagnostic
```

KeyRingDiagnostics inspects the CSRF key ring for multi-instance safety.
Mirrors InstanceSafetyValidator + SharedKeyConfiguration (C#): a single
key or missing keys are legal but risky at scale — every instance must
share the same ring or tokens issued by one instance fail on another.

## func KeyRingFromEnv

```go
func KeyRingFromEnv() *CsrfKeyRing, error
```

KeyRingFromEnv builds a key ring from APIPILOT_CSRF_KEYS /
APIPILOT_CSRF_ACTIVE_KEY. APIPILOT_CSRF_KEYS is a comma-separated list of
"keyId:base64key" pairs.

## func New

```go
func New(Options, *CsrfKeyRing, BindingResolver) *Middleware, error
```

New creates a Middleware. When opts.Csrf.Enabled is true, a key ring must be
provided (or KeyRingFromEnv is used) and a binding resolver (or
DefaultBindingResolver).

## func ResolveEndpointPolicy

```go
func ResolveEndpointPolicy(bool) CsrfEndpointPolicy
```

ResolveEndpointPolicy combines per-route flags into the effective policy.
Precedence: Require > Skip > UseGlobal — mirrors CsrfEndpointPolicyResolver.
Later flags do not override earlier ones of higher precedence.

## func Serialize

```go
func Serialize(any, JsonOptions) []byte, error
```

Serialize marshals v to JSON applying the JsonOptions serialization modes.
Mirrors JsonSerializerConfigurator (C#). Envelope keys are already
camelCase so naming policies are identity on them; the transform applies
recursively to the data payload.
